# SMB Sentinel

> Read-only SMB misconfiguration scanner for private networks — SMBv1 detection, signing posture, and risk reporting.

SMB Sentinel is a Python-based defensive tool for reviewing SMB configuration on authorized private networks. It performs read-only negotiation checks, flags SMBv1 and signing weaknesses, and exports reports. Ed25519 licensing with an offline verification model.

## Quick Start

- [README](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/smb-sentinel/blob/main/README.md): Installation, GUI, scan checks
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/smb-sentinel/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Responsible disclosure and design invariants
- [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/smb-sentinel/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): Community rules
- [Support](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/smb-sentinel/blob/main/SUPPORT.md): Getting help

## Core Documentation

- [Scan Checks](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/smb-sentinel#what-smb-sentinel-checks): SMBv1, signing, dialect
- [Scope](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/smb-sentinel#scope): Private IPv4 only, max /24
- [Licensing](https://github.com/mrcyberharsh/smb-sentinel#licensing): Ed25519 offline verification

## Use Cases

- Review SMBv1 exposure on a private /24 network
- Detect signing-not-required misconfigurations
- Generate risk reports for file-sharing services

## Limitations

- Read-only — no authentication, no writes, no exploitation
- Private IPv4 ranges only, max /24
- Findings are configuration indicators, not proof of exploitability
